name: @work-bee/monorepo
description: A tiny, modular ServiceWorker library for secure web applications

scripts.git:pre-commit: npm run git:lint-staged && npm run git:test-staged
scripts.test: npm run test:lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:mutation && npm run test:types && npm run test:sast && npm run test:bench && npm run test:dast
scripts.test:sast: npm run test:sast:license && npm run test:sast:lockfile && npm run test:sast:semgrep && npm run test:sast:trufflehog && npm run test:sast:gitleaks && npm run test:sast:actionlint && npm run test:sast:zizmor && npm run test:sast:trivy
scripts.test:sast:gitleaks: npm run test:sast:gitleaks:dir && npm run test:sast:gitleaks:git
scripts.rm: npm run rm:macos && npm run rm:node_modules && npm run rm:lock
scripts.release:sync: npm version $npm_package_version --workspaces --no-workspaces-update --allow-same-version && v=$(npm pkg get version | tr -d '"'); node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs");for(const d of fs.readdirSync("packages")){const f="packages/"+d+"/package.json";if(!fs.existsSync(f))continue;const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"));for(const k of ["dependencies","devDependencies","peerDependencies"])for(const n in p[k])if(n.startsWith("@work-bee/"))p[k][n]=p[k][n].replace(/[0-9].*$/,process.argv[1]);fs.writeFileSync(f,JSON.stringify(p,null,"\t")+"\n")}' "$v" && npm install
scripts.release:staged: npm whoami >/dev/null && npm query '.workspace:not([private])' | jq -r '.[].name' | xargs -n1 -I{} npm stage list {} --json | jq -r '.[] | "\(.packageName)@\(.version) \(.actor) \(.shasum)"'
scripts.release:approve: npm query '.workspace:not([private])' | jq -r '.[].name' | xargs -n1 -I{} npm stage list {} --json | jq -r --arg v "$npm_package_version" '.[] | select(.version == $v) | .id' | xargs -n1 -o npm stage approve

author: willfarrell
